[font=Arial][size=6][url=https://github.com/weizinai/StardewValleyMods/blob/main/SpectatorMode/Docs/Readme.md]中文介绍[/url]|[url=https://github.com/weizinai/StardewValleyMods/blob/main/SpectatorMode/Docs/ChangeLog.md]中文更新日志[/url][/size]

[size=6]Introduce[/size]

[size=3]This mod allows you to see the world in spectator mode.[/size]

[size=6]How To Use[/size]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Pressing the Spectator Location keybind ([color=#ff0000]F6 by default[/color]) from within the game will bring up a list of location choices, select a location to enter Spectator Mode.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]In multiplayer mode, pressing the Spectator Player keybind ([color=#ff0000]F7 by default[/color]), a player selection list will appear, select a player to enter spectator mode.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]In multiplayer mode, pressing the Rotating Players keybind ([color=#ff0000]F8 by default[/color]) will randomly spectate a player every 30s (configurable).[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Arial]
[size=6]Feature[/size]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Spectate Location[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Spectate Player[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Rotate Player[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Arial]
